nodes.name: .npmrc
nodes.summary: npm configuration enabling legacy-peer-deps so installs ignore strict peer-dependency conflicts, accommodating the Firebase v10 / Expo dependency tree.

nodes.name: babel.config.js
nodes.summary: Babel configuration for the Expo app applying the babel-preset-expo preset and enabling the API cache for faster rebuilds.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the function-form config with api.cache(true) for deterministic caching.

nodes.name: 2026-03-22-phase1-implementation.md
nodes.summary: Detailed Phase 1 implementation plan breaking work into 12 sequenced tasks (types, storage, share button, online timer, touch snapping, tutorial overlay, quick match, Firestore rules) with a final verification and commit summary.
nodes.languageNotes: 1591-line task-by-task plan with explicit file maps and per-task success criteria.

nodes.name: 2026-03-22-phase1-design.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1 design specification covering five features (interactive tutorial, online 15s turn timer, touch snapping precision, share-result button, quick-match matchmaking queue) with constraints, trust models, and Firestore schema/rules.
nodes.languageNotes: 626-line spec organized per-feature with goals, files affected, and success criteria.

nodes.name: firestore.rules
nodes.summary: Firestore security rules governing access to rooms, matchmaking, users, and coinTransactions collections: authenticated reads/writes for rooms and matchmaking, owner-scoped user docs, and read-only audit-trail coin transactions.
nodes.languageNotes: rules_version 2; matchmaking write rule permits either owner writes or a match-resolution write where status == 'matched'.

nodes.name: theme.ts
nodes.summary: Default parchment theme tokens (colors, player accents, shadows, handwritten Caveat fonts) consumed by the theme system and board/UI components.
nodes.languageNotes: Exported as a const assertion (as const) so token keys/values are literal-typed.

nodes.name: firebase-shim.d.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript ambient module declarations re-exporting @firebase/* internals as firebase/app, firebase/auth, and firebase/firestore so TS resolves the v10 web SDK under node moduleResolution.
nodes.languageNotes: Ambient .d.ts using declare module + export * to work around Firebase v10 type resolution.

nodes.name: sw.js
nodes.summary: Service worker for the standalone index.html PWA implementing precache install, stale-cache cleanup on activate, cache-first fetch for local assets, and network-first for Google Fonts to enable offline play.
nodes.languageNotes: Versioned cache (dotsboxes-v2) with skipWaiting/clients.claim for immediate activation.
